To send good requests to local plumbers, I need a few details:

1) Address  
• Full service address in Portland (including ZIP)  
• Portland, Oregon or Maine?

• How urgent is this? (emergency today, same_day, or routine)

• Preferred time window? (morning, afternoon, 09:00–12:00, etc.)

• Do you already have the new faucet, or should the plumber supply it?  
• Is the current faucet a standard 1‑hole/3‑hole sink setup, or something unusual (pull-out sprayer, separate side sprayer, filter tap)?  
• Is there a garbage disposal or dishwasher line connected that might need to be disconnected/reconnected?  
• House, apartment, or condo? Any building rules about work hours?

Once you answer these, I’ll request quotes from multiple plumbers and show you the options.</action>
